target.title: fix(googlechat): cap two warn-once Sets via createDedupeCache
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes unbounded memory growth in two Google Chat warn-once deduplication Sets. Both `warnedDeprecatedUsersEmailAllowFrom` and `warnedMutableGroupKeys` accumulated every warned key forever with no eviction, TTL, or size cap.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replaced both unbounded `Set<string>` instances with `createDedupeCache({ ttlMs: 0, maxSize: 4096 })`, imported from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/dedupe-runtime` per extension boundary policy. The `check()` method provides touch-on-read LRU semantics.

## User Impact

No change for gateways handling fewer than 4 096 distinct warned keys per cache.

## Evidence

### Proof 1: Module loads cleanly with the SDK import

```text
$ pnpm vitest run extensions/googlechat/src/monitor-access.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ googlechat inbound access policy > issues a pairing challenge for unauthorized DMs ...
 ... 13 passed (13)
```

All 13 existing tests pass with the patched module.

### Proof 2: `createDedupeCache` with the same params (ttlMs=0, maxSize=4096)

```text
$ pnpm vitest run src/infra/dedupe.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ createDedupeCache > keeps entries indefinitely when ttlMs is zero or negative
 ✓ createDedupeCache > touches duplicate reads so the newest key survives max-size pruning
 ... 5 passed (5)
```

### Proof 3: Plugin boundary contract passes

```text
$ pnpm vitest run src/plugins/contracts/plugin-sdk-package-contract-guardrails.test.ts

 ✓ keeps extension sources on public sdk or local package seams  ... 22 passed (22)
```
